recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-style cosmic portrait featuring a central subject framed within a rounded-corner rectangle, set against a deep space starfield with a horizontal nebular glow. The aesthetic combines soft-focus red-tinted photography with sharp, chrome-effect futuristic lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm red-lit central portrait vs. cold blue-black cosmic background
Sharp geometric chrome lettering vs. soft organic portrait textures
Framed inner composition vs. expansive outer space environment
Horizontal light streak bisecting the dark background behind the frame
coreInvariants: Horizontal soft-white nebular glow across the center
Rounded-corner frame with a thin teal or light blue stroke
Monochromatic red lighting on the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central portrait occupying 60% of the vertical space, contained within a decorative frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized chrome-effect title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Title -> Subtitle -> Framed Portrait -> Bottom corner logos.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space around the central frame filled with scattered stars.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Red (Subject and inner frame lighting)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Chrome/Silver with purple and orange gradients (Title)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark void and the intensely saturated red subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with extended horizontal bars
letterConstructionRules: Letters are interconnected by horizontal strokes
Heavy chrome beveling with internal gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial and final letters have elongated horizontal tails that frame the word
Circular elements replaced with multi-colored checkered patterns
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-tech chrome display lettering paired with a classic, understated lowercase serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the soft, friendly 70s serif aesthetic for subtitles

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep navy starfield background with a soft horizontal white nebular glow across the center. In the middle, place a large rounded-corner rectangle frame with a thin teal border. Inside the frame, place a soft-focus portrait of a person with voluminous hair, entirely tinted in a monochromatic deep red wash.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, custom-lettered chrome title at the top center with purple-to-orange gradients and sharp beveled edges. Below it, inside the frame, add a subtitle in a small, light-weight lowercase serif font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Does the title have a metallic chrome bevel?
Is the frame border thin and teal?
Is the background a dark starfield?

adjustableVariables: Color of the horizontal nebular glow
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Record label logos in the corners
Specific graphic on the subject's shirt

avoid: Bright primary colors outside the red tint

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome lettering looks three-dimensional
Verify the horizontal glow doesn't overpower the portrait
Confirm the frame corners are smoothly rounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Monochromatic Tinted Portrait] inside a [Rounded Frame] set against a [Starfield Background] with [Chrome Interconnected Lettering] at the top.
